text: Risk management is the process of identifying, assessing, and controlling threats to a project or business. The first step is identifying potential risks, such as financial loss, technical problems, or changes in the market. Once risks are known, teams can develop mitigation strategies to reduce their impact. For example, they might create backup systems or train staff in new skills. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, which are alternative actions if the main plan fails. Finally, monitoring is essential. Risks change over time, so regular reviews help you spot new dangers and check whether your strategies still work. Good risk management protects resources and helps projects succeed.
